verdict.rationale: The Orama GitHub README lists "Pinning Rules (Merchandising)", which covers the pin part of per-query curation, but only as a bare feature-list entry with no detail on how rules are defined or matched to queries. "Fields Boosting" is field-level weighting, not boosting specific hits for specific queries, so it does not count toward this story. missing for 10: synonym definition, hiding/excluding specific hits per query, per-query hit boosting, documentation of how pinning rules work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries
